name: device-ops-outcome-api
title: Device ops first-class API: install options/progress/cancel, structured root/remount/uninstall outcomes
description: Proxy ADBProxyDevice gains additive install_with_options (replace/grant/test-only/downgrade/user flags, 1MiB progress, CancellationToken cancel, chunk-safe response parsing), uninstall_with_outcome, root_with_outcome/unroot_with_outcome (restarting/already/refused classification, root() stops treating refusal as success), remount_with_outcome (full read, relaxed success detection). Existing APIs delegate to the new ones. Additive error variants; no new runtime deps beyond tokio-util rt feature.
creator: --help
